intelligence.enrichment: Rocks are made up of minerals. Important metals such as aluminium, gold, copper, and iron are extracted from minerals. Rocks take thousands to millions of years to form, so they should be conserved and used responsibly. Because rocks and minerals form very slowly and provide materials for many uses, heavy use without responsibility can deplete resources that cannot be replaced quickly. The learner correctly applies this rule: Rocks are made up of minerals. Important metals such as aluminium, gold, copper, and iron are extracted from minerals. Rocks take thousands to millions of years to form, so they should be conserved and used responsibly. Rocks, minerals, and metals are interchangeable names for the same thing.
